purpose: Low-token story planning index for AI-authored story, event, and quest work. Read this before world-specific context so future drafts know which summary files to open and what to update after delivery.
readOrder: data/worlds/<world>/story_summary.md only when a fuller prose recap is needed
Exact sequence, quest, event, travel map, or activity file only for the slice being authored

tokenBudget.fastDraft: Use the global index, current world story_context/index.json, and live save overlay only.
tokenBudget.branchDraft: Also open the arc's listed sequence index or quest chain file.
tokenBudget.implementationDraft: Open exact target files after choosing the arc, chapter, event bucket, or quest bucket.

beforeDrafting: Pick one world, one arc, and one content type: main story, event, quest, or hub update.
Check live GM notes and runtime branches first; they are newer than static files.
Check current and potential consequence points: alignment, world alignment, relationship, reputation, heat, debt, noise, infection, or route flags.
Do not spend tokens reading full old arcs unless the current arc explicitly depends on exact dialogue or node operations.
afterDrafting: Return a story_context_update JSON block in notes_for_integrator.
Summarize the new story or event in one to three short sentences.
Add or update eventSuitability and questSuitability entries for the affected arc only.
Add previousArcCarryover only when an arc closes or a new arc opens.
List new consequence gates and potential points so future AI can see reachable branches without replaying the whole chapter.
conflictRules: Live GM overlay from the current save overrides static markdown and JSON.
story_context/index.json is the compact planning truth; story_summary.md is prose support.
Never erase protected truths or late reveals because a draft needs momentum. Mark them parked, yellow-risk, or red-risk instead.
If a branch is not ready, mark deliveryStatus as in_update and explain the blocker.

choiceAxes.use: care, restraint, recovery, sparing, comfort choices
decisive action, danger acceptance, pressure handling
jokes, clever redirects, trick solutions, social improvisation
public responsibility, promises, family obligations, faction trust

sharedConsequenceModel.recommendedDeltaScale: Use -1, 0, or +1 for most choices. Use +2 or -2 only for visible, memorable decisions.
additionalTrackers: NPC relationship trust, bond, confidence, suspicion, and friendship
